eventMetadata.context_description:
**Trader consensus centers on 33–34°C as the most probable daily maximum for Panama City on August 8, reflecting short-range forecast guidance that places the peak slightly above the long-term August average of ~29–30°C.** 

In Panama’s wet season, afternoon convective showers and thick cloud cover driven by the Intertropical Convergence Zone normally cap temperatures; any delay in cloud formation or reduced rainfall allows greater insolation and pushes readings toward the upper end of the 31–35°C envelope. Current model runs show modest subsidence and slightly drier mid-level air, supporting the tight 43 % / 34 % split between 34 °C and 33 °C. Resolution hinges on the precise timing of convection relative to the daily maximum observation window, with 32 °C and 35 °C serving as realistic tails if timing shifts by even an hour.
